resolved_conflicts.explanation: The August 1924 item spells the lookout William Pratt; the 1925 and 1927 items spell it William Pradt. The story gives each spelling with its date and does not say they are the same person.

The Register dates the present tower to 1933; a February 1924 item reports an earlier tower completed on the peak. The 1933 announcement describes the older towers as wooden, so the 1933 tower may be a replacement. No source states this outright, and the story does not say so.

notes_for_editor: History from 1911 to 1976 comes from newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; those items were not checked against the original papers. The NHLR page is the only source for current status ('remains in active service', undated). Access level is not stated in any source read, so access is omitted; the record's access 'unknown' stays. No trail or visit information found. The Forest Lookouts page has a 1996 'National Register' entry whose text was cut short in the page output, so it is not used. Height 30 ft converted to 9.1 m. Record elevation_m 2419.5 matches NHLR 2,420 m. Record tower kind matches the NHLR description. No corrections proposed. Search results and listing sites about current access were not read, so nothing from them is used. The Forest Service Bradshaw Ranger District page was not read.
